jev_distillation.evidence: "No teacher model." Training sources listed: "hard-labeled classification sets..., multi-annotator sets with real human label distributions, and constructed long states" (16 sources, ~47k items).

installer_policy.reason: No teacher model and no Jev-derived sources in the card. Installer shows the card's 'gemma' licence string as an open question.

readout.notes: Author transformers backend reads label logits in-process. Its alternative OpenAICompatBackend uses standard /v1/chat/completions logprobs=true and top_logprobs=20 (no vendor-only fields with extra_body unset); that author shim is backend-agnostic. Individual llama.cpp/MLX runtime compatibility and parity remain unverified.
readout.portable_notes: Unmodified transformers author server auto-selects CUDA, MPS or CPU: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kushalpatil07/jevify/66f49bff53b3276fecc6b4bd16a31de277bebfaf/src/jevify/backends/transformers_backend.py L91: self.device = device or ("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "mps" if torch.backends.mps.is_available() else "cpu"); L94: from_pretrained_kwargs.setdefault("attn_implementation", "sdpa")  # custom 4D bool masks need sdpa/eager; L95: self.lm = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model, dtype=dtype, **from_pretrained_kwargs).to(self.device).eval(). CPU/MPS BF16 are high-memory candidates (51.612 GB BF16 +25%=64.515 GB, plus OS). Portable speed/parity not measured. Unlike runtime compatibility, shim backend_agnostic is a source property: openai_compat.py L76–84 only calls standard /v1/chat/completions with logprobs/top_logprobs; optional extra_body must be empty. Set true for that author backend. This does not certify any particular llama.cpp/MLX server or create an unverified conversion.

image_input.transport: state key 'image' or 'images' holding an http(s) URL, a data:image/... URI, a PIL image or an existing local file path (vendor jevify/prompting.py and images.py)

serve.recipe_source: author README; intake vendor jevify_gemma4 (VENDOR-SOURCE.json, prompting.py, backends/openai_compat.py)
steps: jevify serve --model kushalpatil/jevify-gemma4-26b-a4b  (author: POST /v1/systemone, Jev wire format)
Or serve with vLLM and call Jevify.from_runtime('vllm', repo) (author README); port not stated

variants.expected_speed: About 0.17 s raw p 50 per decision on the BH measurement box (0.49 s adjusted). One prefill per question. Provisioning class: H 100 80 GB; this names a memory class, not a latency measurement or confirmation of architecture compatibility. CPU/Mac speed is estimated only in separate portable variants.
variants.notes: 51.6 GB BF16 weights in 2 shards; ROSTER and aggregates estimate 56 GB VRAM (min 56). Recommended 80 GB = weights + KV/activations headroom for long states (the card allows states up to 24k tokens in training). Base revision not pinned by the card (see the base_model block). Host RAM provisioning estimate: pinned weight files sum to 51.612 GB; ×1.25 loader/runtime allowance rounded up to 4 GB gives 68 GB. This is not a measured peak; FP32 initialization or duplicate weight buffers may require more.
